title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Adds Connection Count Policy
summary: AlloyDB's autoscaling feature for read pools now supports scaling based on the number of active connections. You can configure a `targetCount` to automatically adjust read replica nodes to maintain desired connection levels.
details: The `Policy` schema within AlloyDB's autoscaling configuration has been extended with a new `connectionsCount` property. This property references the newly introduced `ConnectionsCount` schema, which allows you to specify an optional `targetCount`. This enables developers to configure autoscaling to dynamically scale read pool instances based on connection load, complementing existing CPU utilization and schedule-based policies.
